Title: Army Forge URL Source: https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/armyInfo/5wbcv465hacdwvkb/2/preview Markdown Content: [![Image 1: Home](https://army-forge.opr-cdn.com/app/onepagerules_round_128x128.png)](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/) Rebel Guerrillas [Studio](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/studio "Army Forge Studio") [Sign In](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/auth/signin) GF - Rebel Guerrillas v3.5.3 ## Intro Rebel Guerrillas are a diverse band of outcasts and agitators from a variety of alien species. Lacking the heavy weaponry of more organized factions, the Rebel Guerrillas rely on their diverse skills to carry them through. The Rebel Guerrillas come from many places throughout the galaxy, united together by their opposition to the Inner Sphere, a powerful alliance of civilizations in the galactic core. Unable to confront the Inner Sphere on equal footing, they have been forced into hiding or exile. Some Rebels have now come to the Sirius Sector, looking for resources and allies for what most view as a hopeless struggle. ## About OPR OPR (www.onepagerules.com) is the home of many free games which are designed to be fast to learn and easy to play. This project was made by gamers for gamers and it can only exist thanks to the support of our awesome community. If you want to help us in making more awesome content, you can support us on www.patreon.com/onepagerules Thank you for playing! ## Background Story While most see the Inner Sphere as a haven of peace, prosperity, and progress in a galaxy filled with strife, the Rebel Guerrillas define themselves by their opposition to it. The organization traces its origins to the Mandar sector, which fell into civil war and collapse, caused by groups who sought to break away to join the Inner Sphere. Many within Mandar blamed the Inner Sphere’s ruling Galactic Council for their support and funding of these break away elements. Those who refused to accept the resulting peace and gradual integration into the Inner Sphere formed the Rebel Guerrilla movement, continuing the war even though their former factions had collapsed. These Rebels sought out new allies both within the Inner Sphere and in nearby Sectors, gradually organizing opposition to the Inner Sphere into a broad coalition. Few in number and unable to challenge the Galactic Council on equal terms, the Guerrilla’s have scattered themselves throughout the galaxy, as their hidden cells work tirelessly to undermine the Council’s influence wherever possible. Their membership draws on a mix of those disaffected by life within the Inner Sphere, and daring adventurers and mercenaries who seek to challenge the most powerful organization in known space. While lacking the infrastructure and organization of more traditional factions, the Guerrilla’s are able to draw on a variety of species, tactics, and technology from throughout the galaxy. For those in the Sirius Sector, the conflict between the Rebel Guerrillas and Galactic Council is a remote one, which they hold little stake in. However, the Guerrilla’s sophisticated technologies from Mandar and the Inner Sphere have attracted the attention of a number of factions in Sirius. The Guerrillas have no interest in overthrowing the local regimes, but have been known to get involved with local conflicts when they feel it necessary. Sometimes, they may serve as mercenaries and allies to local factions when their interests align, whilst at other times they may steal tech or help potential recruits defect or escape prison. The Guerrillas try to avoid escalating these conflicts, and as a result many within the Sirius Sector do not realize the true scale of their organization. Rebel Guerrillas v3.5.3 ## Army-Wide Special Rule Guerrilla:Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee. ## Special Rules Ambushing Piercing Shot:Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule. Counter-Attack:Strikes first when charged. Courage Buff:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Fortified:When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). Furious Mark:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Furious against once (next time the effect would apply). Guerrilla Boost:If most models in this unit have Guerrilla, they may move by up to 6" from Guerrilla (instead of only 3"). Hit & Run:Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee. Lacerate:When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6. Piercing Tag:Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove markers from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(Y) on their weapons, where Y is the number of removed markers. Precise:Gets +1 to hit when attacking. Shielded:Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Surge:On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). Takedown Strike:Once per game, when it's this model's turn to attack in melee, it may make one attack at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown. ## Aura Special Rules Bane when Shooting Aura:This model and its unit get Bane when shooting. Guerrilla Boost Aura:This model and its unit get Guerrilla Boost. Regeneration Aura:This model and its unit get Regeneration. Rending in Melee Aura:This model and its unit get Rending in melee. Shielded Aura:This model and its unit get Shielded. Strider Aura:This model and its unit get Strider. ## Army Spells **Aura of Peace (1):** Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply). **Mind Breaker (1):** Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger. **Bad Omen (2):** Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which friendly units gets Furious against once (next time the effect would apply). **Wave of Discord (2):** Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 2 hits with Blast(3) and Lacerate. **Deep Meditation (3):** Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get +1 to hit rolls when shooting once (next time the effect would apply). **Piercing Pulse (3):** Pick one enemy model within 24", which takes 3 hits with AP(4).
